socioeconomicIntegration.title: Employability and career integration
socioeconomicIntegration.description: Young people's employability remains at the heart of our offer: guidance, application tools, interviews, professional confidence and tangible progress towards employment.

twoWayApproach.title: A two-way approach
twoWayApproach.description: We support both talent and organisations to narrow the gap between market needs, available skills and expected performance.

internationalExperience.title: International experience
internationalExperience.description: Our work and field experience draw on assignments in Canada, the United States, Spain, France, Colombia, Cuba, Ghana, Cameroon, Togo and Côte d'Ivoire.

structuredSupport.title: Structured support
structuredSupport.description: Every engagement connects a clear understanding of the need with the next step, an action plan and follow-up. Our aim is not to multiply promises, but to make the path ahead clearer.

whyChoose.title: Why choose KRAAK?
whyChoose.description: Rigorous, practical support grounded in your real goals.

internationalExpertise.title: Internationally recognised expertise
internationalExpertise.description: Expertise applied across several settings to meet both local and international needs.

personalisedSupport.title: Personalised support
personalisedSupport.description: Every profile is unique, so we adapt the framework, pace and deliverables to the real context.

measurableResults.title: Tangible, measurable results
measurableResults.description: Our approach connects every action to an observable and useful next step.

gettingStarted.question: I am not sure where to start. What is the first step?
gettingStarted.answer: Start by sharing your goal, context and timeframe through the contact form. We will then guide you to the right starting point.

businessSupport.question: Do you offer support for businesses?
businessSupport.answer: Yes. KRAAK also supports organisations with project management, staff training, recruitment and team performance.

consultationFormat.question: Are consultations available in person or remotely?
consultationFormat.answer: Consultations can take place remotely or in person, depending on your needs, the service and the project's constraints.

closing.titleLine1: You know where you want to go.
closing.titleLine2: We know how to help you get there.

hero.titleSuffix: to strengthen careers, projects and organisations.
hero.description: KRAAK Consulting works across three complementary areas of expertise, alongside a dedicated offer for organisations. Every engagement starts with a concrete need, a clear framework and an identifiable next step.

training.title: Help people present themselves with confidence, clarity and job-ready skills.
training.description: This area supports young people, students and early-career professionals who need to clarify their direction, strengthen their application toolkit and position themselves more effectively in the job market.
training.audience: Young people, students, early-career professionals and people repositioning themselves or changing careers.
training.challenge: You have potential but need to clarify your plans, strengthen your application toolkit and build confidence.
training.deliverables: Career guidance, CVs and cover letters in French and English, interview preparation, professional English and French, personal development workshops and transferable skills.
training.nextStep: Book an initial assessment to identify the right format: a short workshop, focused support or a more comprehensive programme.

projects.title: Structure an idea, mobilise the right resources and move a valuable project forward.
projects.description: This area supports businesses, start-ups, organisations and project leaders who need scoping, planning, partnerships or operational support to turn an intention into a manageable path forward.
projects.audience: Businesses, start-ups, organisations, associations and project leaders.
projects.challenge: You need to turn an idea into a clear, fundable and manageable project that can attract the right people.
projects.deliverables: Scoping and planning, partnership development, talent identification, support for businesses and start-ups, workplace preparation and placement.
projects.nextStep: Share your needs so we can define the scope, priorities and most useful form of support.

mobility.title: Prepare for international study, work and mobility with a clear method.
mobility.description: This area supports individuals and organisations that need to clarify an international plan, understand the available options and prepare appropriate steps for the profile, goal and destination.
mobility.complianceBody: the information provided in this context is intended to guide and prepare your plans. Official requirements may vary by country or programme and may change as procedures evolve.
mobility.audience: People seeking to study or work abroad, business opportunity seekers and organisations needing international guidance.
mobility.challenge: You need to clarify the options, understand the procedures and prepare plans that fit your profile.
mobility.deliverables: Strategic guidance, advice on studying and working abroad, exploration of business opportunities, immigration policies and strategies, and preparation for social and professional integration.
mobility.nextStep: Book a consultation to clarify your goal, target country and preparatory steps.

business.title: Targeted solutions for human capital, team cohesion and performance.
business.description: This dedicated offer is for organisations seeking to recruit more effectively, improve collaboration, strengthen internal leadership or raise organisational performance.
business.audience: SMEs, start-ups, organisations, leadership teams and HR teams.
business.challenge: You need to recruit and onboard more effectively, improve collaboration or help your teams progress.
business.deliverables: Talent identification, recruitment support, professional development workshops, staff training, organisational leadership, performance improvement and team cohesion.
business.nextStep: Tell us about your context to receive a tailored proposal or focused intervention.

offers.workplaceCulture: Workplace culture and healthy working relationships

clarify.title: Clarify
clarify.description: We start with the real need, the level of maturity and the decision that needs to be made.

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: We define the right format, expected deliverables and operational priorities.

advance.title: Move forward
advance.description: We put the next step into motion within a clear framework for follow-up.

faq.title: Identify the right service before you begin.
faq.description: KRAAK helps turn your goal into a clear, practical and useful form of support.
faq.panelDescription: Find quick answers to common questions about our services, support formats and response times.

serviceChoice.question: How do I choose the service best suited to my goal?
serviceChoice.answer: We start with your main goal, your context and your most important constraint. Where needed, we guide you towards the right combination of training, project support, immigration guidance or business services.

initialGuidance.question: Do you offer an initial guidance session before we begin?
initialGuidance.answer: Yes. An initial consultation helps clarify the need, identify the right format and define the next useful step.

organisationSupport.question: Is your support only available to individuals?
organisationSupport.answer: No. KRAAK also supports businesses, start-ups, organisations and HR teams according to the type of need and the level of structure required.

closing.title: Choose the right starting point for your needs.
closing.description: One consultation is often enough to identify the most relevant offer, format and next step.
